hypothesis: A 12-warp CTA may reduce CTA scheduling overhead compared with the 8-warp parent while using fewer threads per CTA than the faster 16-warp candidate, potentially balancing scheduling and occupancy. This geometry-only variant keeps one warp per target and uses no shared-memory tiling; its effect remains to be measured.
notes: Prior valid search outcomes were 0.0001530019 s for the 8-warp parent, 0.0001173889 s for 16 warps, and 0.0001601249 s for 32 warps. These measurements motivate testing an intermediate size but do not predict its result. The controller should run timing only after correctness checks pass.
transformations: Set block to 384 threads (12 warps) and items_per_block to 12, retaining zero shared-memory allocation.
